newsitem.title: UK: T&N appoints Much chief executive.
newsitem.headline: T&N appoints Much chief executive.

text.p: UK automotive parts and engineering company T&N said on Wednesday it was appointing Ian Much chief executive from September 1.
Chairman Sir Colin Hope would remain responsible for the group's overall strategic direction, the group said in a statement.
Much is currently chief executive operations with responsibility for operational management and organic development of all product groups and for management development and personnel.

"It is gratifying to me that we have been able to fill the position of chief executive from within the group in having a candidate of Ian's stature and with a proven track record of successfully working with this close management team," said Sir Colin in a statement.
